description: This file is a Java source class defining a utility helper, NavigationHelper, for managing navigation flows in the OrangeHRM Selenium test framework. It provides static methods for performing actions like login, logout, and page navigation, encapsulating common UI flows within the test automation suite.

classes.name: NavigationHelper
classes.description: A stateless utility class providing static methods for navigating and managing sessions in the OrangeHRM web application during automation testing.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs full login flow: navigates to login page, enters provided username and password, submits the form.

methods.name: loginAsAdmin
methods.description: Logs in as the configured admin user and waits for the dashboard.

methods.name: loginAsEss
methods.description: Logs in as the configured ESS user and waits for the dashboard.

methods.name: navigateToLoginPage
methods.description: Navigates to the login page and waits for the login form to become visible.

methods.name: navigateToPage
methods.description: Navigates to a specified relative URL and waits for the page to load.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user by clicking on the user dropdown and selecting logout.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Deletes all browser cookies to clear session data.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks whether a user is currently logged in by verifying presence of user dropdown.
